scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "WAJIK,LK21,NEXT" -c "yellow,blue,cyan" "cd wajik-anime-api && npm run dev" "cd lk21-api && npm start" "next dev -p 3000"
scripts.dev:network: concurrently -k -n "WAJIK,LK21,NEXT" -c "yellow,blue,cyan" "cd wajik-anime-api && npm run dev" "cd lk21-api && npm start" "next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000"
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently -k -n "WAJIK,LK21,NEXT,TUNNEL" -c "yellow,blue,cyan,magenta" "cd wajik-anime-api && npm run dev" "cd lk21-api && npm start" "next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000" "npx cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:3000"
